**On calibrated representations and the Plancherel Theorem for aﬃne Hecke algebras**

*James Parkinson∗*

34 pp, 14 sections.

**Abstract.** This paper has two main purposes. Firstly we generalise Ram’s combinatorial construc- tion [23] of calibrated representations of the aﬃne Hecke algebra to the multi-parameter case (including the non-reduced BCn case). We then derive the Plancherel formulae for all rank 1 and rank 2 aﬃne Hecke algebras, using our calibrated representations to construct all representations involved.
